title: Harbor Country Adventures

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: As the sun bids adieu, hop aboard the Emita II and cruise away from Michigan City into a glorious sunset! Every night, our top deck will have live entertainment that’ll make you want to dance like no one’s watching. With our freshly spruced up main deck and those lovely open-air windows, you can soak in the lake’s breathtaking views while sipping on your favorite drinks from our full bar. Cheers to that! Starting Monday Aug 18th Cruise times will be adjusted to 6:30 pm - 8:00pm (central standard time)due to the sun setting earlier. ALL SEATING IS GENERALMany tours sell out so it is recommended to arrive early. Boarding starts 30 Minutes prior to departure Tickets are non-refundable, but are

blurb: Harbor Country Adventures offers a variety of activities including chill cruises, wild rides on the Searocket boat, solo paddle rentals, and luxury motor coach rentals for touring local wineries and distilleries. Located near Indiana Dunes National Park, it provides options for thrill-seekers and those looking for a laid-back experience. The business operates in northwest Indiana and southwest Michigan, close to the Great Lakes.
extraNote: Regular 2026 Boat Tour Season concluded; Pop Up Sunset cruises in September

quotes.author: Terry Wright
quotes.text: The boat excursion was very fun. The Captain was very informative about the lake and Indiana Dunes National Park. We definitely would come back and do it again!

quotes.author: Christa Reichardt
quotes.text: We had a wonderful time on the boat tour. Everyone was knowledgeable, professional, and courteous. It was relaxing and informative. I would highly recommend.

quotes.author: Liz Dahm
quotes.text: We had a blast on the boat celebrating Emily's birthday! This was our second time with you and both were exceptional! Definitely recommend!!

quotes.author: Katie Garibaldi
quotes.text: We had a great time, though the DJ needs to work on his emcee skills. Weird comments especially towards women and he had no shame.
